raw_text: Massive anti-CAA protests erupting across Northeast India. Coordinated bandh calls circulating on social media with specific instructions for blocking road and rail networks. Reports of clashes in Guwahati's Chandmari area. Security forces deployed in large numbers across Assam. #CAA #NortheastProtest #AssamBandh
